body.statement: If \(D^{\circ}\neq\varnothing\), the infimum and supremum of \(b\) over \(\mathcal M_{+}\) equal \(L\) and \(U\). The lower endpoint is attained in \(\mathcal M_{+}\) if and only if some \(z\in C_{\theta_U}\cap D^{\circ}\) satisfies \(b_{\theta_U}(z)=L\); the upper endpoint is attained if and only if some \(z\in C_{\theta_L}\cap D^{\circ}\) satisfies \(b_{\theta_L}(z)=U\).
body.justification: Strict log-odds models can lose endpoint attainment at marginal contacts even when their closure has the same bounds.
body.gap: CiocaneaTeodorescuGabrielSjolander2025 assumes positive cells; the exact closure-to-strict transfer and finite attainment criterion under assay uncertainty are not given there.
body.consumer: Software and applied reports can distinguish an attained sharp bound from a merely approachable sensitivity limit.
